name: xahau-uritoken-broker
description: Ephemeral broker hook for URIToken (NFT) marketplace sales on Xahau. A buyer sends XAH to the broker account with the token id + max ask; the hook buys the listed URIToken, remits it to the buyer, routes a broker fee (net of all chain costs incl. the remit reserve), and auto-refunds a failed buy.
